_comment: Freshness policy for the dockerized demo. Same shape as freshness-companion/examples/policy.local.json, but source_url points at the demoserver service on the compose network instead of 127.0.0.1. Durations use Go syntax (5m, 1h, 24h). on_unverifiable: bypass | serve_with_warning. on_unknown: auto | revalidate | serve_with_warning | bypass.

guard._comment: Requests kept out of the cache entirely. tool_results: a request carrying a tool's result is built from live data. side_effect_tools: a cached text answer would skip the action.

categories._comment: No discover block here: the offline demo never searches. policy.tavily.json and policy.discover.json show the optional 'discover' block (Tavily finds the source), used only with -discover.
categories.name: price

facts._comment: source_url is the demoserver container serving freshness-companion/demo-page (bind-mounted, so editing the file on the host is reflected immediately -- demoserver disables caching).
facts.name: Acme Pro plan price
